candidate_generation.purpose: high-recall desk-review leads, not automatic MWE annotation
candidate_generation.token_basis: TECO-provided casefolded lemma and stable textid/itemid/position
candidate_generation.contiguous_rule: exact OEWN multiword-verb lemma sequence within one inferred sentence
candidate_generation.gap_rule: two-member OEWN verb form in order within one inferred sentence, with 1-8 intervening TECO word items
candidate_generation.sentence_boundary_rule: infer a boundary from sentence-final punctuation in local ia; do not export ia
candidate_generation.line_rule: increment an inferred line at each lmost=1 item; retain source lmost/rmost flags without assuming that their totals are paired
known_recall_limits: no gapped search for forms with more than two members
no gap longer than 8 word items
TECO-provided lemma errors propagate to this screen
punctuation-based sentence inference may split abbreviations or miss atypical boundaries

roi_contract_frozen_before_outcome_join.primary_analysis_unit: member word observation joined by textid and itemid, with occurrence ID and member order retained
roi_contract_frozen_before_outcome_join.primary_member_rule: include reviewed MWE members only; do not silently include gaps
roi_contract_frozen_before_outcome_join.gap_sensitivity: analyze the first-through-last span, including gap items, only as a labelled sensitivity
roi_contract_frozen_before_outcome_join.line_sensitivity: retain each member's lmost/rmost and the derived crosses_inferred_line stratum
permitted_occurrence_summaries: all_members_skipped and any_member_skipped, with missing retained
sum of nfix and tfd over members only when every contributing value is observed
not_whole_mwe_measures: sum of binary regin, refix, or reread indicators
roi_contract_frozen_before_outcome_join.non_derivable_from_wordmeasure_v1: a fixation-sequence-defined whole-span first-pass or regression-path duration
roi_contract_frozen_before_outcome_join.coverage_counting_rule: conventional word coverage keeps every orthographic word token; a reviewed MWE contributes one occurrence to the separate MWE-form denominator and never changes the word-token denominator

included: OEWN canonical form and sense count
